name: WALKFLOW Demo — Real Estate: Feedback, Follow-up, Next Step

parameters.content:
PREPARED, NOT TESTED. See 01-enquiry-matching-assignment.json's setup note for credential/webhook-secret setup.

Handles record_viewing_outcome and preview_followup. The Function node ports nextStepFor() from src/components/demo/real-estate/engine.ts so Connected Mode branches (interested/not-interested/needs-info, missed/cancelled) match Preview Mode exactly. No real email/WhatsApp/SMS is ever sent — only a row in demo_real_estate_message_previews, which the website displays as a labelled preview.
